game.core.world.secret.summary: The wagon has a false bottom, cut and reset by a Bramblebridge cartwright who owed a debt to a moneylender. Somewhere along the route the real silver was swapped for lead-weighted sacks and offloaded at a covered mill outside town; the seals were never broken because the swap happened before the wagon was sealed for the day. Expected solution path: examine the wagon's underside (Investigation), trace the route and timing (Insight/Investigation with witnesses), confront or catch the cartwright. Reward: 30 gp finder's fee plus real goodwill with the tollhouse if the silver is recovered; 75 XP for solving it, more if handled with unexpected cleverness or mercy.
